parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.value: ={{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.filePath.match(/(video|image)/)[0] }}/{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.filePath.split('.').pop()}}

parameters.command:
=ffmpeg -y -i "{{ $json.filePath }}" \
  -vf "scale=1080:-2,fps=30" \
  -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -level 4.1 -pix_fmt yuv420p \
  -preset medium -crf 23 -g 60 -keyint_min 60 -movflags +faststart \
  -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ac 2 -ar 48000 -r 30 \
  "{{ $json.filePath }}.temp.mp4" && \
mv "{{ $json.filePath }}.temp.mp4" "{{ $json.filePath }}" && \
echo "{{ $json.filePath }}"

parameters.content:
## **1. Vytvoření obrázku pro post**
Nahraje obrázek do databáze ve formátu vhodném pro html
